title: Ruapehu Crater Lake theodolite observations, 1988
credit: Don Swanson, United States Geological Survey; subject Brad Scott, New Zealand Geological Survey
altText: Volcanologist Brad Scott making theodolite observations at Ruapehu Crater Lake in 1988.
caption: New Zealand Geological Survey volcanologist Brad Scott using a theodolite near Ruapehu Crater Lake in 1988 to monitor volcanic activity.
context: A documented scientific observation connected to recurrent volcano-monitoring measurements later assembled with lake chemistry and seismic data. It is a photographic field measurement, not a GIS screenshot.
